name: The Lost Pilot
summary: Pilot Hammerfoot waits at the wrecked siege engine, fearing for Mori Hildelve in Dun Morogh's crags. Hildelve went on foot to find rare ore for potent blastpowder, but days have passed, and roars echo through the peaks.

sections.title: A Search Cut Short
sections.body: Pilot Mori Hildelve drove his siege engine up Dun Morogh's steep, jagged ridges while searching for rare ore needed to make high-grade blastpowder. The machine broke on the slope. Hildelve left Pilot Hammerfoot at the camp to guard the wreckage, then continued higher into the frozen wilderness on foot.

sections.title: Echoes in the Snow
sections.body: Days passed without Hildelve returning to camp. At night, vicious growls echoed from the rocky crags, and Hammerfoot's impatience turned to dread. Hildelve was known for his toughness, but the frigid heights offered little protection from prowling predators without his engine or heavy support.

sections.title: A Grim Discovery
sections.body: Mori Hildelve's trail ends in the crags, where his remains lie exposed to the elements, mauled and stripped by mountain scavengers. His roughly scribbled notes are clutched in his lifeless hand. A Brigadier's Vest still drapes his ruined frame, marking the violent end of the siege engineer.

faq.q: Why was Pilot Hildelve out in the wilderness alone?
faq.answer: Hildelve went into the wilderness to search for rare ore needed to make high-grade dwarven blastpowder. When his siege engine broke on a steep slope, he continued into the crags on foot rather than abandon the search.

faq.q: Who sends you to look for Hildelve?
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot, Hildelve's friend and fellow siege engine operator, asks you to investigate. Hildelve had left Hammerfoot behind to guard their damaged machinery while he scouted ahead.

faq.q: What happened to Hildelve's siege engine?
faq.answer: Hildelve wrecked the siege engine's mechanics while trying to drive it up a steep, icy hillside in search of ore. The machine was left stranded in the snow.
Hammerfoot has heard beastly growls in the hills and fears for Hildelve. Following the pilot's trail reveals his fate.

faq.q: What proof is found at Hildelve's remains?
faq.answer: Hildelve's roughly scribbled notes are clutched in his hand, and a Brigadier's Vest in fine condition remains around his frame.

faq.q: What happens after Hildelve's body is discovered?
faq.answer: Finding Hildelve reveals what happened during his search. The evidence found there carries the investigation onward.

angles.text: As a dwarf, the loss of a skilled siege engine driver to wild beasts strikes close to home. Even Khaz Modan's familiar hills hold lethal dangers.
As an engineer, you know the dwarves keep searching for volatile minerals to refine into potent explosives and blastpowder.
